analysis.one_line_summary: A curly-haired creator demos drying her curls in under 10 minutes using the pink Wavytalk high-speed hair dryer with diffuser attachment.
analysis.full_description: A creator sits in her bedroom holding the pastel pink Wavytalk hair dryer with large diffuser attachment. She states that it is the fastest diffuser she has ever used and sets an iPad timer to prove it. After a quick demo cut, she shows the stopwatch stopped at 9 minutes and 53 seconds, explaining that her hair is already 85% dry compared to 30 minutes with her standard Walmart dryer. She shows her fully dried, bouncy, defined curls and directs viewers to the details below.
